meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", "share skills", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行操作开发工作区与终端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常切换开发工作区并用终端执行操作。
copy.tagline_en: Manage dev worktrees and terminals from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often switch between dev worktrees and use terminal commands.

howto.what: Claude 会改用 `orca` CLI 操作 Orca 管理工作树、终端、浏览器等;涉及 Orca 状态时优先于裸 git、PTY、Playwright。执行命令前先跑 `ORCA skills get orca-cli` 获取指南。
howto.when: 当你说“$orca-cli”“Orca worktree”等触发词,或要求 spawn codex/claude、共享 HTML/Markdown、控制内置浏览器,且任务涉及 Orca 管理状态时触发。

say.text: 用 $orca-cli 列出当前 Orca 工作树。
say.note: 会先取版本匹配指南再执行。

say.text: 在 Orca 工作树 spawn codex,完成后 full handoff。
say.note: 触发子工作树与交接流程。

say.text: 读取 Orca 终端,然后发送一条命令。
say.note: 走 Orca 管理的终端,不建临时 PTY。

howto.what_en: Claude will use the `orca` CLI for Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, and embedded browser, preferring it over raw git worktree, PTYs, and Playwright; it first runs `orca skills get orca-cli` for the matching guide.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "full handoff", etc., or any task touching Orca-managed state.

say_en.text: List the current Orca worktrees with $orca-cli.
say_en.note: It fetches the guide first, then runs the command.

say_en.text: Spawn codex in an Orca worktree, then do a full handoff.
say_en.note: This triggers the worktree and handoff flows.

say_en.text: Read the Orca terminal and send a command.
say_en.note: Uses the Orca-managed terminal instead of a raw PTY.
